Ravi Singh (CS): Heads-up: Sable Advocate's EU pilot failed during a partner demo. Their outbound is NAT'd from two /30 ranges. They want an allowlist + brief QPS lift. Renewal touch in 6 days.
Elena Rossi (SE): Please paste the CIDRs and requested QPS/duration. Any strict data residency?
Ravi Singh (CS): CIDRs: 198.51.100.248/30 and 203.0.113.12/30. Request: bump 30 -> 110 QPS for 36h. Pin to eu-west-1. Data residency: must keep data in EU.
Maya Iyer (Onboard): They tripped burst protection during the demo. If we can't stabilize this, renewal risk goes up. Can we do autorevoke and a 24h pre-expiry reminder?
Tom Blake (NetEng): We can add both CIDRs to the edge allowlist, tag expiry and autorevoke. No maint window. Will smoke-test after apply.
Elena Rossi (SE): I'll add a project routing override to prefer eu-west-1 and bias KV cache locality. Also set a soft safety cap at 140 QPS.
Ravi Singh (CS): Ops payload (expiry RFC3339):
```
allowlist:
  - cidr: "198.51.100.248/30"
  - cidr: "203.0.113.12/30"
allowlist_expires: "2026-04-12T09:00:00Z"
rate_limits:
  project_id: "sable-advocate-prod"
  qps: "110"
  duration: "36h"
region_pin: "eu-west-1"
soft_limit: "140"
```
Maya Iyer (Onboard): please schedule revocation job + slack reminder 24h before expiry. tag CRM: "escalation-mitigated" if demo succeeds.
Tom Blake (NetEng): Applied and smoke-tested from EU edge (simulated source). Firewall logs show accept for both CIDRs. Revocation job queued. :white_check_mark:

Elena Rossi (SE): leaving notes on routing override and cache bias in the project config.
Tom Blake (NetEng): all set. change reverts automatically on expiry. :thumbsup:
